action: opened the order: Invent one new widget that goes beyond everything in the catalog. One remarkable idea, or none.
person at the terminal: proposed Aim (aim-widget), Bylaws (bylaws-widget), Gloss (gloss-widget)
Delight: proposed Unsent (unsent-widget), Famous Last Words (quickfix-widget), You Were Right (vindicated-widget)
Untapped capability: proposed Provenance (provenance-widget), Veil (veil-widget), Outbox (outbox-widget)
took the order at ideation

stamped reject on "Veil": It covers replies and tool rows but not the prompt box or other plugins' cards, so a privacy tool that is partly blind costs more in false trust than it gives, and walking transcript element trees to mask text is fragile.

stamped reject on "Outbox": Whether a user plugin sees the engine's own telemetry rows is unverified and can only be settled by a live test in the person's session, and a partial tally presented as what the CLI reports would mislead.

stamped reject on "Aim": Not chosen: a sound sibling of stakes-widget on the same dialog line, but it only helps people who drive kube, cloud or terraform through Claude, and Provenance reaches everyone with a git history.

stamped reject on "Bylaws": Not chosen: its headline moment rarely happens because reading a file loads the CLAUDE.md above it before any edit, and the list that remains is close to what /memory and /context already show.

stamped reject on "Gloss": Parsing flag tables out of --help text differs per tool and per platform (git --help opens a browser on Windows), so it would be wrong or silent often, for an answer Claude gives on request.
stamped reject on "Unsent": A novelty that amuses once: it keeps text the person chose to erase and gives them nothing to act on.

stamped reject on "Famous Last Words": A variation on timer-widget and the waiting wager-widget and insight-widget: turn length filed under a keyword, with words like just and small matching most prompts.

stamped reject on "You Were Right": A joke with a counter; its one serious part, marking agreement hollow when the next check fails, is what calibration-widget and flow-widget in waiting already measure.
named the widget provenance-widget ("Provenance")

stamped pass: Provenance is the only idea that makes a new join, from a line of code back to the prompt that asked for it, with typed API throughout, no model cost, and a moment a person would show a colleague.
